description: This file defines the LDAPService class responsible for managing LDAP connections and queries within the OrangeHRM application. It provides methods to obtain LDAP adapters, establish connections, perform queries, and handle LDAP entries.

classes.name: LDAPService
classes.description: A service class providing LDAP connection management, query execution, and configuration handling within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the LDAP connection object implementing ConnectionInterface.

methods.name: getAdapter
methods.description: Initializes and returns the LDAP adapter used for communication with the LDAP server.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Performs LDAP bind operation using provided user credentials.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Creates and returns an LDAP query object based on the specified distinguished name, query string, and options.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes special characters in LDAP search strings.

methods.name: getEntryManager
methods.description: Retrieves the EntryManager object for LDAP entries management.
